details.name: Improvement: root-cause share
details.message: Fixing causes: 60% of the 311 cards finished this week fixed a cause or added a system, the rest fixed one more case of a repeat problem (last week 53%). 36 problems keep coming back; 25 have a card to fix the cause, 11 more get one over the next days. 4 fixes claimed to stop a repeat, and it came back anyway. An independent check of 8 fixes from this week, reading only the code, found 6 of 8 fixed the cause.

details.name: Improvement: done claims that held
details.message: Done claims that held: 88% (534 of 608) over 30 days, 88% (175 of 199) over 7 days; 16 more could not be checked on the recheck machine.
